messages:
marina: Heads-up — getting multiple escalations from EU-Central3 customers about 502/504s + timeouts to the hosted inference endpoints starting ~09:10 UTC. Customers report transient auth failures then retries getting 5xx. I see spike in gateway errors on the dashboard (per-route 502 rate up 8x). ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-2384 (severity: high)
raj: digging into tcp captures now. initial look shows increased retransmits and occasional TLS handshake resets on egress to ISP AS64500. Packet loss ~0.8-1.5% for short bursts, looks correlated with higher p99 latency on connection setup.
support-bot: customer 7892 opened escalation ticket — mentions repeated 502s and billing concerns (calls out failed requests that still consumed tokens).
sam: can you paste a minimal repro? I want to try a curl against the same model route.
marina: repro steps customer provided: 1) POST to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with api_key header 2) payload small prompt 3) notice 502 or socket reset ~10-30s in. They test from eu-central region.
marina: Customer provided curl: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4-slim","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -m 60```
raj: ran a few probes from our euc-host test instances. Sample logs: ```TCP_OUT reset_by_peer src=10.4.3.12:443 dst=3.220.45.10:52034 seq=... retransmits=3```. Provider peering shows microbursts and BGP path change around same time.
liu: checking traceroutes and BGP: cloud-net: confirmed short-lived as-path flaps for prefix 3.220.45.0/24 across POP euc3-border. Provider ticket 554321 created.
cloud-net: just opened a high-priority with carrier — they see interface errors on edge router and are rerouting but TTL for mitigation unknown.
sam: mitigation options: 1) shift traffic away from eu-central3 for affected routes (policy-level fallback to eu-west2) 2) enable faster connection retries that don't bill idempotent token consumption 3) temporary 429 backoff to clients? 4) disable long-lived keepalives to force new TLS sessions on healthy paths. Thoughts?
marina: product/account notified. Billing team flagged customers concerned about being charged for failed attempts. Need a clear repro window for credits.
raj: quick tech note — failure mode seems to be TCP reset during TLS handshake or early request body send. So some requests are failing before the model actually consumes tokens. We need to ensure we don't bill for those.
support-bot: logged customer IDs impacted: 7892, 8011, 8125. Collecting request ids and timestamps.
marina: immediate action: can we add a routing rule to prefer eu-west2 for the Hosted API for affected customers? That will avoid carrier path.
cloud-net: added temporary route policy: traffic to model-catalog endpoints from euc3 edge will try eu-west2 pop as fallback for 30m. Rolling out now.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline: canary rollout of route-policy change started (deploy-id: route-2026-66).
sam: also enqueue a job to scrub billing for requests that returned before auth success / before request accepted by runtime. We need a list of request_ids where upstream connection error occurred. raj can you export logs?
raj: exporting logs now. Pattern to match: "upstream connection reset" or "TLS handshake failure" + route=euc3. Will hand off to billing with CSV.
liu: for SRE followups: capture PCAPs on euc3 border for next hour, keep metric retention higher for per-route errors, add alert on sudden retransmit % > 0.5% for >5 minutes.
marina: customer comms: sending a status note explaining root cause is carrier path instability and we rerouted them and will review billing. Draft below — please thumbs up / edits: 
---
Hi — we saw intermittent carrier-level packet loss in EU-Central (euc3) causing connection resets and 5xx responses to API calls. We’ve rerouted traffic to an alternate pop and are working with the provider to remediate. We will review any failed requests for credits; please share any request IDs you have. ETA next update 30m.
---
raj: +1. add note: if you saw socket reset between client and our edge, that request likely failed prior to token consumption.
marina: legal asked for timeline and list of impacted prefixes for compliance. cloud-net: provider gave AS64500 interface logs; attaching ticket ref 554321.
support-bot: customer 8011 replied confirming improved success rate after 10:55 UTC.
sam: longer term mitigation ideas: multi-path egress, active path probing, and per-tenant fallback policies. Also, better pre-accept checks so billing doesn't attribute tokens for early handshake failures.
liu: postmortem owner? marina volunteers and liaise with cloud-net and billing. I'll create PM for root-cause + action items.
marina: ok thanks everyone — current status: fallback routing deployed, provider engaged, billing scrub started. Will update within 30m or earlier if provider confirms fix. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-2384 status updated -> mitigated (fallback routing live).
marina: filing quick repro checklist for SRE: ```1) run curl from euc3 test node against /v1/generate repeated 1000x at 5 qps 2) capture failures and pattern match upstream reset or TLS error 3) collect request-ids and timestamps 4) forward CSV to billing@redwood.ai```
support-bot: follow-ups logged to ticket INC-2026-2384.
liu: FYI — provider reports interface flaps cleared at 10:42 UTC but they will continue monitoring. We'll keep tracing enabled for 2 hours.
marina: closing thread for now, will reopen if additional customer reports come in.
